name: Svartalfheim
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card when you use PRODUCTION. If you do, choose one type of non-fighter ship produced and produce an additional ship of that type at no cost.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: Forged twice, for the same price.
flavourText: Rich in rare isotopes and raw iron, the planetary magma-wells leave deep scars on the surface. But they also power the foundries of Svartalfheim, forging starships for anyone who will pay.
